# grok-export-tool

> Unofficial local backup of your own Grok Bots and regular Grok chats from grok.com. Runs on a Mac where Google Chrome is already logged in. Writes a JSONL and Markdown archive. A zero-dependency stdio MCP server can query the Bot archive.

## Overview

This repository provides:

- **`grok-bot-export.py`** — exports Grok Bots (roster, transcripts, attachments) and, with `--mode chat` or `--mode all`, regular Grok chats.
- **`grok-bot-mcp.py`** — stdio MCP server, standard library only: `list_bots`, `get_bot`, `search`. It reads a Bot export directory. It does not index a chat export, and it does not open a network connection.
- **`.opencode/skills/grok-export/`** — OpenCode skill for the export-and-query workflow. The skill name is Grok Export.

## Modes

- Default / `--mode bot`: every Grok Bot. Attachments download in parallel, 4 MB chunks, 6 workers unless `--workers` is set.
- `--messages-only` (alias `--skip-attachments`): Bot text only. No effect on chat export.
- `--mode chat`: regular Grok chats. Text and raw JSON. No attachment files. Default folder `~/Downloads/grok-chat-export-YYYYMMDD/`.
- `--mode all`: both. Separate directories. If you pass one directory, chats go to that path with `-chat` appended.

Bot default folder: `~/Downloads/grok-bot-export-YYYYMMDD/`.

Chrome profiles scanned: Default, Profile 1, Profile 2. The first run needs macOS Keychain access to **Chrome Safe Storage**. Logs are Chinese and do not print cookie values. Export directories are mode 0700 and files mode 0600.

## Quick start

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python3 grok-bot-export.py
python3 grok-bot-export.py --messages-only
python3 grok-bot-export.py --mode chat
python3 grok-bot-export.py --mode all
```

## OpenCode MCP

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "grok-bot": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["python3", "/absolute/path/grok-bot-mcp.py", "/absolute/path/grok-bot-export-YYYYMMDD"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Disclaimer

Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI. It reads history for an account you own. grok.com interfaces can change without notice. Do not put cookies, Keychain material, or exported transcripts in issues or commits.
